description: c115 server-pillar coverage: proves PerfectDarkServer.exe boots cleanly to the main loop on a vanilla, no-config invocation. The dedicated server target does NOT link smoke_harness.c (see CMakeLists.txt SRC_SERVER -- the harness is client-only), so this test uses the runtime_strategy='timeout-kill' workflow: launch with vanilla CLI args, wait timeout_seconds, then teardown the long-running daemon process. Assertions are log-only. Confirms the canonical boot sequence: sysInit -> fsInit -> updaterInit (skipped via --no-update-check) -> assetCatalogInit + base BYOR registration -> netInit -> hubInit -> serverBansInit (clean install -> 'no ban file' marker) -> serverAdminInit (no token -> 'no admin token configured' marker) -> SDL_Init (headless via --headless) -> netStartServer -> 'Listening on port' -> 'Entering main loop'. Note: the 'NET: dedicated server mode enabled' line in netInit() is gated on sysArgCheck('--dedicated') (the in-client path), not on g_NetDedicated -- it fires for the client launched with --dedicated, not for the standalone PerfectDarkServer.exe, so this test does NOT assert it. The dedicated path skips the ROM hash check at CLC_AUTH (per context/pillars/server.md): no ROM is loaded, so this test does NOT seed a ROM file in the install dir (Install-Harness.ps1's Target=pd-server branch). Failure modes guarded: ENet init failure (NET: could not init ENet), bind failure (NET: could not create ENet host on port), unexpected ROM check firing (would only happen if g_NetDedicated invariant breaks), and a SERVER: Failed to start error log. First server-pillar smoke fixture; future regression of the pd-server bring-up path lights up here.

input_sequence.comment: no scripted input: pd-server has no harness link, so smoke event injection is not wired. Documented here for parity with client tests so future readers know the absence is intentional.

advisory only -- timeout-kill workflow tears the process down at timeout_seconds (12s); the daemon never auto-exits. 12s covers cold-start variance: SDL_Init(timer), netInit + ENet bind, assetCatalog registration, hubInit, ban/admin parse. Recorded server boot lands the 'Entering main loop' marker around 1.5s.

required_lines: BANS: no ban file at .* \(0 bans loaded\)
forbidden_patterns: NET: could not init ENet, disabling networking
NET: could not create ENet host on port \d+
